sentences.text: The State of West Bengal Mr.
Indrajit Bhattacharjee ... for the petitioner Mr. Rana Mukherjee ... for the State

Learned counsel for
the petitioner and the State are present.
It appears from the revisional application that the proceeding before the trial court is under Section 417/376 of the Indian Penal Code.
It appears that the petitioner has not made the defacto complainant a party in this case.

Accordingly, learned advocate on record is granted leave to add the defacto complainant as the opposite party no.2 in the present case and make the said note in the cause title of the revisional application and is directed to effect service upon the opposite party no.2 and file an affidavit of service on the next date of hearing.
Matter to appear in the monthly list of December, 2024.
